narrative.executive_summary: Your platform currently faces a systemic inventory control failure detected across 11 live missions, with no critical severity but broad medium-risk exposure. Five separate missions flag 15 to 36 products requiring immediate replenishment yet simultaneously recommend 0 units to reorder, creating imminent stockout risk for high-velocity SKUs including Oil (42 units), Biscuits (30 units) and Mouse (28 units). Demand is sharply concentrated across 36 high-velocity products and profit is over-reliant on a single SKU, Mouse (₹39,496.35 profit, 24% of ₹162,180 total), amplifying supplier and margin fragility. Without immediate manual override of automated reorder logic, lost sales and service disruption are highly probable within the current cycle.

threat_vectors.name: Systemic Zero-Quantity Reorder Failure
threat_vectors.description: 5 missions (Zombie Auto-Reorder Loop, Size-Blind Reorder Point, Thin Buffer, Multi-Location Breach, Post-Restock Collapse) flag 15-36 products for immediate replenishment but calculate 0 units reorder volume. Indicates broken reorder logic that will guarantee stockouts if left automated.

threat_vectors.name: Broken Size Curve & Demand Concentration
threat_vectors.description: 36 high-velocity products show severe skew: Oil leads at 42 units, followed by Biscuits (30) and Mouse (28). Risk score 47, the highest detected, signals size-level forecasting is misaligned with actual velocity.

threat_vectors.name: Profit & Supplier Concentration Fragility
threat_vectors.description: Single SKU 'Mouse' drives ₹39,496.35 profit (29.49% margin) representing ~24-26% of total profit (₹162,180 on ₹505,881 sales and ₹152,500 on ₹466,989 sales). 15-21 SKUs share this concentration, creating single-point-of-failure risk on supplier and margin.

threat_vectors.name: Category Overstock-Stockout Coexistence
threat_vectors.description: 21 high-velocity products simultaneously show stockout risk while capital is trapped in low-margin inventory. Data indicates inventory is misallocated by category, not just quantity, driving both lost sales and carrying cost.

immediate_actions: IMMEDIATE (24h): Freeze automated reordering and manually audit all 36 SKUs flagged by Size-Blind Reorder Point and 21 SKUs from Zombie Loop - override 0-unit recommendations with manual purchase orders for top 3 velocity SKUs (Oil, Biscuits, Mouse).
URGENT (48h): Conduct physical inventory and days-of-cover verification for the 15 products in Multi-Location Breach and Post-Restock Collapse missions to prevent imminent stockout.
URGENT (72h): Recalibrate size-level reorder points and safety stock formulas - replace uniform thresholds with velocity-weighted curves based on actual 42/30/28 unit demand pattern.
THIS WEEK: Diversify supplier exposure for top 15 profit-driving SKUs and secure secondary source for Mouse to reduce concentration fragility.
THIS WEEK: Investigate and restore data pipeline for Days-of-Cover vs Lead Time mission which returned 0 records, leaving lead-time stockout gap completely blind.
monitoring_recommendations: Deploy daily velocity vs. days-of-cover dashboard for the 36 high-velocity SKUs with automated alert when cover falls below supplier lead time or when system generates 0-unit reorder recommendation.
Institute weekly profit concentration review tracking Mouse contribution vs. total profit (threshold alert if single SKU exceeds 20% of total) and margin health across 21 tracked items.
Implement continuous audit of auto-reorder loop integrity - flag and escalate any zombie loop where replenishment is triggered but volume remains zero for 2+ consecutive cycles.
